content:
**A2 kickoff (issue #231, approved w/ 2 corrections): fixture-only build, CP-A2 split (a=code now / b=e2e deferred), PLAN-DEVIATION A2-alone; SCIT GitLab endpoint obsolete**

What: Track A resumes with A2 (GitLab governance CI pipeline), issue #231, base feature/v2.0.0. Drafted, reviewed, APPROVED WITH 2 CORRECTIONS (applied to the body), awaiting human status:approved. A1 (ci-context.mjs) already in tree.

Deliverables: (1) ship brain/scripts/ci/gitlab-governance.yml as an `include: local:` file (do NOT clobber consumer root .gitlab-ci.yml); decision + consumer include-line adoption cost (F1 inherits) argued in an ADR draft to brain-drafts/. (2) jobs mirror GOVERNANCE_JOBS 1:1 by name. (3) drift-guard test over BOTH YAMLs. (4) issue-link + configurable approvedLabel (status::approved OR status:approved).

CORRECTION 1 (exit-code semantics by class — A1 Amendment 3, do NOT flatten): REQUIRED → fail-closed (0/1, uncomputable FAILS CLOSED); GitLab = normal jobs. DETECTION (phase-order, actor-check, brain-writes-reviewed) → two cases: uncomputable → warn + exit 0; real finding → visible fail; GitLab = allow_failure: true. Flattening to "uncomputable fails closed" for detection would break actor-check's zero-false-positive contract.

CORRECTION 2 (environment): the SCIT self-hosted GitLab is INACCESSIBLE for days; the prior endpoint 10.1.30.x is OBSOLETE (purged from the issue; recorded here). A2 is built ENTIRELY fixture-tested (code-vs-execution, migrate-v1 precedent). CP-A2 SPLIT: CP-A2a = code + fixtures + drift-guard (NOW, hard stop, PR-as-review); CP-A2b = e2e validation (real MR blocked/passing on live GitLab) DEFERRED until the human restores access + provides a NEW address/tier.

PLAN-DEVIATION (recorded): the plan couples CP-A2 to "A2+A3" assuming the real-MR demo needs GitLab provider verbs (A3). It does NOT — the demo needs only normalized ci-context (A1) + the pipeline (A2); mrCreate/protectBranch are for ACTING on GitLab, not EVALUATING an MR context in CI. A2 ships alone; A3 is a sibling with its own checkpoint.

Confirmed user answers: (a) include: as ADR recommendation, argued in design incl. F1-inherited adoption cost; (b) 10.1.30.4:90 NOT current; (c) A2-alone approved.

Next: human status:approved → branch off feature/v2.0.0 → SDD artifacts (proposal/spec/design + ADR draft/tasks) → strict TDD → STOP at CP-A2a, PR-as-review, Part of #231. Related: [[sdd/issue-229-c4/done]].
